t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a mobile version beside it, no device frame, no people. Deep navy blueprint interface showing <CONTENT> as outlined cards placed like nodes of a flowchart, joined by thin orthogonal connector lines. One card is active: it is wider, outlined in a single steel-blue accent, and holds the answer text with a small line chart. All-caps monospace type in limestone off-white, numbered labels like 01 /, tiny coordinate tags in card corners, crosshair registration marks, hairline 1 px borders, no fills, calm dark negative space.
signature_idea: The FAQ as a flowchart of question nodes where the open one widens sideways instead of pushing the list down.
strengths: navy, limestone and one steel-blue accent match the brand palette
numbered questions and widening card are a distinctive, buildable pattern
mobile version shows a sensible stacked fallback
weaknesses: all-caps mono for long questions is hard to read
fake coordinate tags are decorative noise
flowchart connections imply a logic between questions that doesn't exist
brand_fit_why: Palette, square corners and mono labels fit; all-caps mono body text breaks the Geist light headline rule.
